Local simulator

From the Hackathon directory run bash flightpath-vscode/start.sh. Paste the access code printed in its terminal.

Replay available without a bridge.

SITL uses stock 3 kg / 350 mm / 3S quad physics. The 650 mm / 6S CAD airframe is a concept visualization. Columbia locations are inherited, unsurveyed route inputs; terrain and buildings are absent. No physical vehicle or payload actuator is connected.
